sub_theme: Hybrid microgrid sizing, operation and techno-economics (off-grid zones and grid-connected)
methods: Study types: modelling-simulation 11; techno-economic-assessment 2. Method keywords (matched in the extracted method field): genetic algorithm 4; PSO 3; HOMER 2; iHOGA 2; MILP/MINLP/NLP/LP 2; optimal power flow/dispatch/unit commitment 2; review/bibliometric 1
settings: Sectors: non-interconnected-zones 13. Departments/scope: La Guajira 7; Chocó 4; Amazonas 2; San Andrés y Providencia 2; Boyacá 1; Arauca 1; Valle del Cauca 1; Nariño 1; Guaviare 1; Guainía 1; national scope 1
technical: PV-battery optimum with diesel never selected: PV 22-29 kWp plus battery 74-93 kWh [R0010] | 100% renewable share with zero diesel fuel use [R0042]; 96.81% renewable share [R0002] | LPSP under 0.25% in diesel-assisted configurations [R0418] | simplified battery models overestimate life up to three times [R0002]
economic: LCOE 0.35-0.38 US$/kWh vs 0.86-4.51 US$/kWh for diesel [R0010] | LCOE 0.49 EUR/kWh for current system, 0.36 EUR/kWh optimal lead-acid, 0.20 EUR/kWh lithium option [R0002] | LCOE 0.23-0.35 USD/kWh diesel-assisted vs 0.29-0.44 USD/kWh fully renewable [R0418] | lowest LCOE 0.161 USD/kWh with PV, 0.524 USD/kWh for Case I [R1558] | LCOE 0.754 USD/kWh (environmental priority) vs 0.514 USD/kWh (economic priority) [R0668]; 1,087.69 (Chocó), 857.15 (La Guajira) and 867.42 (Guainía) COP/kWh [R0855] | LCOE 1.61 $/Wh (SHS 1) down to 0.65 $/Wh (GF/SHS 3) [R0228] | payback 2.01 years [R0042]; 25-year expenses 88.4% lower than diesel-only [R0042] | dispatch cost 189, 182 and 196 COP/kWh vs 518 COP/kWh for the traditional grid [R0645]
environmental: no-diesel variant about 60% lower emissions [R0418] | avoids 4248 kt CO2/yr versus grid [R0100] | 18.97 tCO2e/yr vs 29.94 tCO2e/yr across objective priorities [R0668]
pattern: Studies agree that PV/wind-battery hybrids undercut diesel (LCOE 0.35-0.38 US$/kWh versus 0.86-4.51 US$/kWh for diesel in R0010; 25-year expenses 88.4% lower than diesel-only in R0042; dispatch cost 189, 182 and 196 COP/kWh versus 518 COP/kWh for the traditional grid in R0645), but cost metrics differ in currency and unit (US$, EUR, USD, COP/kWh and $/Wh in R0228), so figures are not directly comparable. Fully renewable designs cost more than diesel-assisted ones (LCOE 0.29-0.44 versus 0.23-0.35 USD/kWh in R0418) while cutting emissions (no-diesel variant about 60% lower), and battery model choice matters (simplified models overestimate life up to three times in R0002).
